subject: Pilot credit amplification request — ZeroDay Labs
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@zeroday.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@zeroday.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request — accelerator pilot credits review

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at ZeroDay loved the throughput on the smaller models. Quick ask: our compute estimate for the three-month pilot ran higher than anticipated (attached usage extract). The accelerator program cap hits us around week 3 unless we throttle experiments.

Is there any flexibility to increase the free pilot credit allocation or do a one-off top-up for this cohort? We have procurement and investors watching velocity and this would materially affect our evaluation. If there are constraints, can you share the commercial path (discount vs. consumption top-up) so we can give procurement a choice?

Attached: zeroday_current_usage.csv (summary)

Appreciate any options you can share,
Sara Patel
Head of ML Ops
ZeroDay Labs

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@zeroday.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request — accelerator pilot credits review

Hi Sara — great to hear the demo landed well. Short answer: yes, we can consider an exception, but I need to run two options by our programs team.

Option A (quick): 50k token top-up applied to the existing pilot allocation — immediate, no contract change.
Option B (preferred): an amplified pilot package — 150k token bridge + 20% usage discount for engineering experiments; would require a one-page exception term sheet and finance sign-off.

I attached a short options sheet (rdw_pilot_credit_options.pdf) that outlines the tradeoffs and recommended internal approvals. If you can share the procurement contact / billing email we can draft the term sheet for option B.

Would you be open to a 30-min call tomorrow to pick between A/B?

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Strategic Startups
Redwood Inference
Attachment: rdw_pilot_credit_options.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request — accelerator pilot credits review

Marissa / Mina — forwarding ZeroDay's ask. Key facts: high early compute, customer wants either a small top-up or a larger amplified pilot with short discount window. They are good fit for our accelerator (early-stage, demo traction).

Q: Can programs approve Option B (150k bridge + 20% usage discount) with a one-page exception? Finance will need the term sheet but procurement wants to see it tonight. Risk: if we over-index free credits and they burn without conversion we miss predictability. Suggest we make the amplified pilot conditional on a short commitment (60-day conversion checkpoint) and usage cap tiering.

Marissa — can you confirm if we have headroom in promotional budget for a July/Aug cohort carve-out?
Mina — if we proceed, can you draft the one-page exception (pins: deal id DEAL-8742, expiry 60 days, cap at 200k burst absolute, 20% usage discount on billable overage)?

Thanks,
Sean

Cc: procurement@zeroday.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 16:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request — accelerator pilot credits review

Hi Sara — following internal review we can make an exception for this cohort. Summary of the approved carve-out: 

- Amplified pilot: 150,000 token bridge applied to your accelerator account (one-off grant)
- 20% usage discount on billable consumption for any usage beyond the grant for 60 days from activation
- Absolute burst limit of 200,000 tokens in any 24-hour window (safeguard)
- Exception conditioned on a 60-day conversion checkpoint and a short term sheet to be countersigned

I've attached the exception term sheet (zeroday_exception_term_sheet.pdf) and a DocuSign link to execute. To proceed, please confirm the procurement contact and billing email and sign the term sheet. Once signed we'll apply the grant within 24 hours.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&PowerFormId=abcd-1234-efgh-5678
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/ZeroDay-Labs-DEAL-8742

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to jump on a call if you want to review the safeguards.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Strategic Startups
Redwood Inference
Attachments: zeroday_exception_term_sheet.pdf
